top_signals.title: India’s Annual Wind Power Installations to Double by 2030
top_signals.summary: India’s record-setting annual additions of wind power capacity could double by the end of the decade, a senior executive at major wind turbine maker Suzlon Energy told Bloomberg on Thursday. Last year, India installed a record 6.3 gigawatts (GW) of wind power generation capacity. This year, the annual installations are set to top that record and reach 8 GW, and annual additions could then double to about 14 GW by 2030, Suzlon Energy’s executive vice chairman, Girish Tanti, told Bloomberg TV on the sidelines of the Bloomberg New Economy…
